title: No Items In Hand
description: Removing items from first person POV for better vision.
body:
**give a credit for this if you are using it for your texture pack or part of your project. THIS TOOK ME LONG TIME TO MAKE**

DISCLAIMER
----------
**Ensure the pack is allowed on whatever the community you are in**

Some community like speedrunning ban any texturepack provides visual advantage.
Hence I am not taking any responsibility when you are getting banned by using this texturepack.

ALSO DISCLAIMER
---------------

**This pack doesn't work with the pack that assign item to another model**

What this pack does?
--------------------
**This pack removes the items that you are holding from first-person pov (including off-hand)**

it still shows item in third person pov / other player




**Huge shout out to beni3939 who suggested this pack and send me some of his GIF for gallery**
